components.name: temporal primitive-instruction retirement
components.project_addition: Combines suffix adequacy with structural cut clutters under an explicit resource policy. Future weakening pushes minimal deletion cuts outward and minimum instruction cardinality cannot increase, but local minimum bases need not nest. Under no-reacquisition, instruction selection becomes a temporal hitting problem and currently redundant primitives may have positive anticipatory value. Reacquisition is treated as an explicit future capability rather than a hidden implementation assumption.
